components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that advances the task. Drafting-blue fill, white label, 4px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1858c9; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #1858c9; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 13px; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(24, 88, 201, 0.28); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0f449c; border-color: #0f449c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1858c9; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #edf1f3; border-color: #d9e0e5; color: #66737e; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Button
components.description: Standard sheet action: white fill, rule-strong border, graphite label.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #ffffff; color: #101820; border: 1px solid #b4c0c8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 13px; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f7f9fa; border-color: #66737e; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1858c9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive or void actions. Red ink and border; red wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #ffffff; color: #bf2b1f; border: 1px solid #e3b7b2; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 13px; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fcebe9; border-color: #bf2b1f; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1858c9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Ruled drafting field with a blue focus ring. Values that are measurements use the mono face.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #101820; border: 1px solid #b4c0c8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 10px; min-height: 36px; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #66737e; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1858c9; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e7effc; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #edf1f3; color: #66737e; border-color: #d9e0e5; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Fixed dark bench rail. Active destination is a drafting-blue plate; icons are a single 1.6px stroke.
components.css: .ds-rail-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 4px; color: #9fb0bd; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 550; text-decoration: none; } .ds-rail-link:hover { background: #16232f; color: #e9eff4; } .ds-rail-link.is-active { background: #1858c9; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Domain and sharing identity. Blue is logic, ochre is analog, amber wash is shared. Always carries a label.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #d9e0e5; border-radius: 3px; background: #f7f9fa; color: #46525d; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-chip.is-analog { background: #fbeee2; border-color: #ecc9a9; color: #a84a00; }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: The work surface. White paper, 1px rule, 6px radius, one small shadow; headers are tracked capital labels.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d9e0e5; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 32, 0.06); } .ds-sheet-head { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9e0e5; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #46525d; } .ds-sheet-body { padding: 14px; }

components.name: Title Block
components.description: The signature move: ruled cells that carry real metadata (updated, revision, domain, components, link). Labels are tracked capital; values are mono.
components.html:
Revisionv4
Domainlogic
components.css: .ds-tb { display: flex; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d9e0e5; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tb-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; padding: 5px 12px 6px; border-right: 1px solid #d9e0e5; } .ds-tb-cell:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-tb-label { font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #66737e; } .ds-tb-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #101820; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Saved, live, complete, read-only, or failed. Tinted wash, 1px border, dot, always with a word.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 7px; border: 1px solid #b9dbc9; border-radius: 3px; background: #e3f4ec; color: #0c7a4e; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stamp::before { content: ''; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-stamp.is-void { background: #fcebe9; border-color: #e6b6b1; color: #bf2b1f; }

keyCharacteristics: Sheets with title blocks, not cards with decoration: metadata lives in ruled cells labelled Updated, Revision, Domain, Components, Link.
One accent for action and one for analog. Blue means do it here; warm ochre is reserved for analog domain identity.
Dense but calm: hairline rules, small tracked labels, generous page margins.
Real information replaces ornament: figure callouts on auth, waveform and netlists in the editor, measured values in mono.
Auth is a split board: a dark drawing sheet carrying the value proposition and a figure, with the form on white paper.
dos: Do mark state with a chip, stamp, or labelled wash; never color alone.
Do set every value, ID, date, count, voltage, current, and node name in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do group metadata into a title block with tracked labels and mono values.
Do give every empty, loading, error, stale, locked, and read-only state its own explicit message.
donts: Don't extend the dark bench rail into content surfaces; the editor is white paper on a light gridded ground.
Don't add a UI framework, icon dependency, or hosted font; faces are self-hosted woff2 beside the app.
Don't let decoration (texture, paper props, gradients) cost legibility or simulation speed.
Don't use a second accent hue for emphasis; blue is action, ochre is analog, red is failure, green is success.
